title: Senior Counsel, Strategic Partnerships
description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Where we Work

Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye. 

About this role

This is a senior in-house legal role for a commercially driven lawyer ready to take commercial legal programs work with partners and negotiate technology deals. The role reports directly to the Head of Commercial Legal, Strategic Growth.
 
We operate a hybrid go-to-market model that combines demand-led direct sales, solution-led growth, and indirect distribution through a tiered partner and channel ecosystem. We reach organizations globally through technology alliances, GSI relationships, channel partners, and reseller arrangements…

title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team.  This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
description:
About Genesis AI
 Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.
 About the Role
 A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.
 We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.
 The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.
 Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.
 You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline…

title: Integrity Operations Specialist
description:
Introduction to Role & Team
 Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.
 You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.
 This role will be based in the U.S. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.
 Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.
 What you’ll do
 Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.
 Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.

title: IT Manager
description:
About the role
 We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving practical problems and making everyday IT work well, reporting into the CIO and based in London.
 A big part of the job is security in a practical, operational sense. You'll keep devices patched and well configured, control who has access to what, bring order to the software and accounts that build up as a company grows, and make joining and leaving smooth and secure. You'll operate the controls and standards that the security team sets, and you'll be the person who makes them real in day-to-day work.
 You'll work across the whole company, so you'll need to balance keeping people productive with keeping them secure, and be comfortable being the go-to person for anything IT.
 Job responsibilities
 Own endpoint security in practice, including device configuration, patching, controlling local admin rights, and reducing unmanaged software
 Look after workplace and network security, including the office network and keeping guest and corporate access properly separated
 Run identity operations day to day, including provisioning, joiner, mover and leaver changes, and regular access reviews
 Manage software and licensing across the company, and bring order to tools that have crept in without oversight
 Manage 3rd party vendors such as internet suppliers
 Look after the office network, devices and everyday hardware
 Run the IT helpdesk and make sure people get quick, helpful support
 Make joining and leaving the company a smooth, well-run experience
